purpose: Require strong destination-market supply routes instead of treating a global catalogue as locally procurable.

cross_market_platform_routes.name: Shopify Storefront MCP / UCP
cross_market_platform_routes.scope: Per-store catalogue and shopping interface; not a universal multi-merchant Product Twin, geometry or local-logistics source.

cross_market_platform_routes.name: WooCommerce REST API
cross_market_platform_routes.scope: Per-store authenticated commerce adapter; catalogue quality, fields and delivery evidence depend on each merchant.

cross_market_platform_routes.name: GS1 Digital Link
cross_market_platform_routes.scope: Neutral identity and linked-information route; does not itself provide current seller offers, 3D geometry or destination delivery.

cross_market_platform_routes.name: Mirakl seller APIs and multichannel integrators
cross_market_platform_routes.scope: Reusable seller-side product, offer, stock, order and shipment integration across Leroy Merlin/ADEO and other Mirakl marketplaces. It requires an approved seller/shop credential and does not expose the complete marketplace catalogue to a buyer application.
cross_market_platform_routes.strategic_use: Onboard authorized suppliers once, enrich their records into Product Twins and syndicate the improved identity/media/3D data outward while retaining dated stock, offer and order evidence inward.

policy: Candidate names are research targets, not claims of API access or procurement readiness. Each connection must separately prove identity, permitted access, offer freshness, destination logistics and avatar rights.
